pkgmetadata.longdescription: PhotoCraft is a clean-room reimplementation of a Photoshop-style editor in pure Rust: layers, masks, adjustment layers, layer styles, type, vectors, brushes and PSD/PSB round-tripping, rendered on the GPU (Vulkan). Installed from the upstream Linux tarball; the binary only links against glibc and loads the graphics libraries at runtime. Early alpha.
